rows.title: Radiation therapy plus mogamulizumab for canine urothelial carcinoma
rows.finding: VSEC Kawaguchi accepts suspected or confirmed canine lower UCC; randomized mogamulizumab or placebo plus firocoxib and compulsory radiation in either arm. Prior chemo/RT/surgery, hydronephrosis or obstruction, IRIS 3–4 CKD and poor prognosis excluded. Funding not published; UCC coordinator research-ucd@vsec.jp. No dated recruitment end; 12 weeks is per patient.

rows.title: Canine cancer chemotherapy study
rows.finding: Midwestern Glendale oncology trial for untreated otherwise healthy validated canine melanoma, HSA, mammary cancer, STS and spindle-cell carcinoma, at least one year old. Chemotherapy and stated exam/bloodwork provided, study team contact via clinical study route. No current published calendar cutoff.

rows.title: Low-dose gastrointestinal radiation for untreated feline small-cell lymphoma
rows.finding: CSU 8528 plus AVMA VCT26005992: biopsy/IHC/PARR untreated feline small-cell GI lymphoma, signs for at least six weeks, anesthesia and no contra-indicated prior meds/recent changes; total 6Gy over three daily fractions, covered study care after initial screening; CSU oncology 970-297-4001 and csuoncologytrials@colostate.edu. Dec 31 2027 AVMA study end governs exact cohort.
